rubric.role_summary: Vice President in investment banking focused on insurance services and distribution. The role leads transaction execution, advises and manages client relationships, and develops junior bankers.
rubric.search_query:
Find candidates for this role:
Vice President in investment banking focused on insurance services and distribution. The role leads transaction execution, advises and manages client relationships, and develops junior bankers.
Mandatory professional qualifications:
- Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Business Administration or a related field with 4 years of investment banking Associate or Analyst experience, or a Master's degree with 3 years of that experience.
- 2 years of insurance services and distribution industry experience.
Preferred, not mandatory:
- Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Business Administration or a related field and 4 years of the specified Associate or Analyst experience; alternatively, a Master’s degree and 3 years of that experience. The experience must involve financial modeling, valuation analysis, transaction execution, due diligence, and preparation of client-facing materials for financial institutions in investment banking or a related industry.
- For 4 years, or 3 years with a Master’s degree, experience with each specified workstream, financial data platform, financial-modeling and analysis method, M&A activity and advisory familiarity, accounting and regulatory standard, and Microsoft application.
- 3 years of experience with each specified activity: reviewing transaction and due-diligence materials; managing multiple multi-party transaction processes; mentoring junior bankers; reviewing and providing feedback on junior team members’ analyses, models, and presentations; supporting client relationships and business development with senior bankers; and communicating findings and transaction considerations to senior clients and internal stakeholders.
- 2 years of insurance services and distribution industry experience, including its business models, regulatory frameworks, key performance metrics, and execution of live transactions.
Work location and geographic eligibility:
Location: New York metropolitan area. Hybrid work is based in this area, and candidates must currently be located in it. Specific cities and metropolitan areas also include any location within about 100 miles (160 km) of them; states, countries, and regions require a location inside them.

preferences.source_quote: Requires Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Business Administration or related field of study, and 4 years of experience as Associate or Analyst involving financial modeling, valuation analysis, transaction execution, due diligence, and preparation of client-facing materials for financial institutions in the investment banking or a related industry. preferences.requirement: For 4 years, or 3 years with a Master’s degree, experience with each specified workstream, financial data platform, financial-modeling and analysis method, M&A activity and advisory familiarity, accounting and regulatory standard, and Microsoft application.
preferences.source_quote: Experience specified must include 4 years of experience (3 years if Master’s degree) with each of the following: leading financial modeling, valuation, transaction structuring and process-related workstreams across multiple transactions; one or more financial data platforms (e.g., Bloomberg, Capital IQ and SNL, FactSet, PitchBook, or comparable); performing financial analysis and modeling, including building integrated three-statement financial models, discounted cash flow (DCF) analysis, leveraged buyout (LBO) analysis, accretion/dilution analysis, and comparable company and precedent transaction analyses; mergers and acquisitions (M&A), including buy-side and sell-side advisory, divestitures, joint ventures, recapitalizations, management buyouts (MBOs), and leveraged buyouts (LBOs), as well as familiarity with fairness opinions and valuation advisory services; U.S. GAAP, SEC regulations, and investment banking compliance standards; and using Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and Word.

preferences.requirement: 3 years of experience with each specified activity: reviewing transaction and due-diligence materials; managing multiple multi-party transaction processes; mentoring junior bankers; reviewing and providing feedback on junior team members’ analyses, models, and presentations; supporting client relationships and business development with senior bankers; and communicating findings and transaction considerations to senior clients and internal stakeholders.
preferences.source_quote: Experience specified must also include 3 years of experience with each of the following: reviewing teasers, confidential information memoranda (CIMs), management presentations, and due diligence materials; managing multiple multi-party transaction processes in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment; mentoring and developing junior bankers; reviewing and providing feedback on financial analyses, models, and presentation materials prepared by junior team members; supporting client relationship management and business development efforts in coordination with senior bankers, including pitch preparation and client communications; and communicating analytical findings and transaction considerations to senior clients and internal stakeholders.
